downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.placeholder: Your downloaded files will appear here
downloads.no_permission: Cannot download a file; missing notification permission
downloads.clear_all_warning: Are you sure you want to clear all the download record ?

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.placeholder: Your saved content will appear here

tags_blocker.title: Tags Blocker
tags_blocker.desc: You can block multiple tags by separating it with space

servers.title: Server
servers.reset_warning:
Are you sure you want to reset server list to default ?

This will erase all of your added server
servers.remove_last_error: The last server cannot be removed
servers.use_custom_api_desc: Useful if server has different API address than the homepage

api_token.label: API token (optional)
api_token.desc: Needed for servers like Monbooru (token with read scope). Stored only on this device in the system keychain, in backups only with "Include login data", and only sent to this server.
api_token.insecure: Warning: this address uses plain HTTP outside your local network, so the token would be sent unencrypted. Use HTTPS.

server_query.title: Query
server_query.urlSuffix: URL Suffix, appended to the end of query URLs

midnight_theme.title: Midnight Theme
midnight_theme.desc: Use darker color for the dark-mode

ui_blur.title: Enable blur
ui_blur.desc: Enable blur background on various UI elements

hide_media.title: Hide downloaded media
hide_media.desc: Prevent external gallery app from showing downloaded files

blur_content.title: Blur explicit content
blur_content.desc: Content rated as explicit will be blurred

blur_timeline_only.title: Only blur content on timeline
blur_timeline_only.desc: Explicit-rated content will not be blurred on view-mode

ime_incognito.title: Incognito Keyboard
ime_incognito.desc: Enable incognito-mode for keyboard if supported.

load_og.title: Display original content
load_og.desc: Load original file instead of the sample when opening the post

post_limit.title: Max content per-load
post_limit.desc: Result might less than expected (caused by blocked tags or invalid data)

save_to_photos.title: Save to Photos
save_to_photos.desc: Also add downloaded images and videos to the Photos app. WebM videos are not supported by Photos and stay in Files.
save_to_photos.no_access: No access to Photos. Allow it in iOS Settings → Boorusphere.

backup.title: Backup data
backup.desc: Backup app data into a file

credentials.title: Include login data
credentials.desc: API tokens (Monbooru servers, monloader) and API keys/user names in the servers' URL suffix (e.g. api_key=…), e.g. to move to another device. Off: they are left out of the backup, restoring on this device keeps them.
credentials.warning: Tokens and login data will be stored in plain text in the backup file, which is visible in the Files app. Only share it with people you trust and delete it after moving.

reading.title: Reading and saved searches
reading.desc: Reading progress, the Continue reading list and saved searches

restore.title: Restore data
restore.desc: Restore app data from backup file
restore.warning:
Warning! this action will overwrite any existing data.
Are you sure you want to continue ?

auto.title: Automatic backup
auto.desc: Backs up all data when the app is opened and the last automatic backup is older than the chosen interval. Older automatic backups are deleted; manual backups are kept.

monbooru.sent: Sent to monloader, waiting for the result…

settings.title: Monbooru (monloader)
settings.desc: Address and token for "Send to Monbooru"
settings.token_desc: Write scope sends posts, read scope shows the result. Stored only on this device in the system keychain; backups only include it with "Include login data".
settings.duplicate_check: Posts are checked for duplicates against your Monbooru server in the server list (by file md5).

error.not_configured: Monbooru is not set up (see Settings)
error.unavailable: Monbooru is not configured in monloader or is paused

backup.title: Monbooru (monloader)
backup.desc: Address for "Send to Monbooru". The API token stays in the system keychain and has to be entered again after restoring on another device.

result.unconfirmed: Sent to monloader. No result to show (the token needs read scope, or the job is still running).

duplicate_dialog.title: Already in Monbooru
duplicate_dialog.desc: The file of this post is already in Monbooru. Send it anyway?

history.title: Monbooru history
history.placeholder: Posts you send to Monbooru show up here with their result.
history.clear_hint: Only this list is cleared, nothing is removed from Monbooru.

signature.desc: After that the app won't open until you install it again with Sideloadly (over the existing app, your data is kept).

gallery.title: Title
gallery.tags_failed: Couldn't load the tags of this gallery.

continue_reading.title: Continue reading
continue_reading.placeholder: Galleries and archives you start reading show up here.
continue_reading.remove_all_hint: The pages you read stay saved.

saved_searches.title: Saved searches
saved_searches.placeholder: Save a search to see how many new posts it has since you last opened it.
